name: Age-normalized launch leader
hypothesis: At a fixed age checkpoint buy the top eligible score of net quote demand, executable return, and breadth within that day's cohort.
spec: Setup: Comparing tokens at equal age may reduce maturity bias in launch selection. Entry: At a fixed age checkpoint buy the top eligible score of net quote demand, executable return, and breadth within that day's cohort. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on rank deterioration or the fixed intraday horizon. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs launchpad creation events, bonding-curve state and decoded swaps (on-chain history not connected)
